description.value: Burrata Pizzeria is a Kerrisdale neighbourhood pizzeria focused on delivering what it calls the most authentic Italian pizza to Vancouver's West Side. The restaurant offers both takeout and delivery, as well as event catering for corporate and private functions. It sits on West 41st Avenue, a key east-west cycling corridor on the south side of Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 49m; bollard (2 spaces) at 57m; bollard (2 spaces) at 58m; stands (2 spaces) at 64m; bollard (2 spaces) at 67m; bollard (2 spaces) at 74m; bollard (2 spaces) at 94m; rack (6 spaces, covered) at 99m. Total: 22 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is an active pizzeria at 2104 W 41st Ave Vancouver with phone (604) 901-8888, matching OSM tags. The website prominently features 'TAKE OUT & DELIVERY' and online ordering links, confirming takeout. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so these remain null.
concerns: Website lists a second phone number not in OSM: (604) 336-6440.
Deals page title references 'Vancouver & Aldergrove', suggesting at least one additional location; the OSM record appears to be for the Vancouver/Kerrisdale location only.
OSM opening hours differ from hours shown on the website; website hours appear more current (site copyright 2025).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active pizzeria with confirmed address, phone, and online presence on a cycling corridor in Vancouver. Useful to touring cyclists seeking takeout pizza.
